author: awe0_io

pageTransitions.descEn: Old page fades out as the new page fades in.
pageTransitions.descZh: 旧页面逐渐消失，新页面慢慢出现。

pageTransitions.descEn: New page slides in from the left or right, like a mobile app.
pageTransitions.descZh: 新页面从左侧或右侧滑入，像手机 App 一样。

pageTransitions.descEn: Page expands from small to full size for spatial depth.
pageTransitions.descZh: 页面从小到大展开，带来空间层次感。

pageTransitions.descEn: A solid color or shape sweeps across the screen to complete the change.
pageTransitions.descZh: 一整块颜色或图形扫过屏幕，完成页面切换。

pageTransitions.descEn: A list image enlarges and continues into the detail page.
pageTransitions.descZh: 列表中的图片放大后，自然衔接到详情页。

pageTransitions.descEn: An element smoothly changes shape while staying visually continuous.
pageTransitions.descZh: 元素从一种形状平滑变成另一种形状，视觉上保持连续。

textMotions.descEn: Split the title into characters that enter one by one.
textMotions.descZh: 把标题拆成一个个字符，依次进入画面。

textMotions.descEn: Characters appear one after another as if being typed.
textMotions.descZh: 文字一个接一个出现，像有人正在输入。

textMotions.descEn: Text goes from blurry to sharp for a soft, premium reveal.
textMotions.descZh: 文字从模糊逐渐变清晰，过渡自然又高级。

textMotions.descEn: Random characters resolve into the correct text.
textMotions.descZh: 文字先变成随机字符，再逐渐还原成正确内容。

textMotions.descEn: Colors inside the text drift slowly, like light moving through the letters.
textMotions.descZh: 文字内部的颜色缓慢移动，像有光线从字里穿过。

textMotions.descEn: Text slides out from a hidden region, like rising from behind a curtain.
textMotions.descZh: 文字从隐藏区域滑动出现，像从幕布后升起来。

stockPromptEnPage: Use Fade Transition between pages, Shared Element Transition when a work card opens into a detail page, Scale Transition for modals, and keep every transition smooth and natural.
stockPromptZhPage: 页面之间使用 Fade Transition，作品卡片进入详情页时采用 Shared Element Transition，弹窗使用 Scale Transition，所有过渡保持流畅自然。
stockPromptEnText: Use Split Text on the homepage title, Blur Reveal on the subtitle, Gradient Shift on keywords, and ease-out easing on every animation.
stockPromptZhText: 首页标题使用 Split Text，副标题采用 Blur Reveal，关键词使用 Gradient Shift，所有动画使用 ease-out 缓动。
